ah_discharge_trapz.source: trapezoidal integral of |current_a| over dt during discharge

efc_cumulative.source: cumulative observed discharge Ah / 2.0 Ah NMC rated capacity

thermal_hours_outside_20_30.source: time-weighted exposure with midpoint temperature outside 20-30 C

v_at_q20.source: voltage interpolated at 20% of cumulative discharge Ah

v_at_q50.source: voltage interpolated at 50% of cumulative discharge Ah

v_at_q80.source: voltage interpolated at 80% of cumulative discharge Ah

caveats: Persistence remains the reference; any improvement is only on the reported test rows.
LFP current units are underdetermined; unit_safe removes all current-derived features.
LFP test contains no gap-crossing pair; the 200->401 pair is in validation.
RUL pre-EOL results are a three-cell leave-one-cell-out diagnostic, not a validated production model.
No formula-generated SOH label was created; measured soh_pct remains the only target.
